---
name: Broken Site Selector
about: Report a platform UI update where a sidebar, profile badge, or media element is no longer cloaked
title: "[Selector] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Target Platform
- [ ] ChatGPT (`chatgpt.com`)
- [ ] Google Gemini (`gemini.google.com`)
- [ ] Claude (`claude.ai`)

## Exposed Element
Which element is no longer hidden or blurred? (e.g., sidebar history item, workspace switcher, start-page greeting, profile menu, uploaded image preview)

## DOM Snippet (Optional)
Paste the outer HTML or `data-testid` / `aria-label` attributes of the element from Chrome DevTools (remove any personal info first).
